hero.greeting: Hi 👋, My name is Md. Nuruzzaman, and I am a Frontend developer based in Dhaka, Bangladesh.
hero.subtitle: I specialize in building modern, responsive web applications.

about.heading: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a passionate Frontend Developer with a keen eye for design and a love for creating seamless user experiences. Based in Dhaka, Bangladesh, I've been crafting web applications for over 3 years.
My journey into web development started with curiosity and has grown into a full-fledged career. I thrive on transforming complex problems into elegant, intuitive interfaces.
When I'm not coding, I enjoy exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, and staying up-to-date with the latest trends in web development.

items.title: Portfolio Website
items.description: A personal portfolio built with Next.js, GSAP animations, and Tailwind CSS showcasing my work and skills.

items.title: E-Commerce Dashboard

items.title: Task Management App
items.description: A Kanban-style task manager with drag-and-drop, real-time updates, and team collaboration features.

items.title: Weather Application
items.description: A beautiful weather app with animated backgrounds, location detection, and 7-day forecasts.
